text:
Samir: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — wanted to capture the staffing clarifications we promised. I'll answer a few questions here.
Priya: Thanks. Is hiring frozen or just reprioritized?
Samir: Not a hard freeze. We're pausing non-critical IC reqs for ~90 days to concentrate spend on infra/SRE/model-serving. Strategic and revenue-facing roles continue.
Javi: To add detail: Eng gets 10 new headcount slots for next quarter, mostly infra/runtime and 2 senior SWE ICs. Manager hires are restricted unless it's a direct backfill from a promoted IC.
Leah: Product — are growth/PMM engineers blocked? We have roadmap deliverables tied to hires.
Priya: Product-facing roles are OK if tied to revenue or SLA ownership. Please submit a 2–3 bullet justification to people-ops and cc your manager.
Ian: For org map changes — if a pod loses a role, how will redeploys be handled?
Priya: We'll run a 2-week internal mobility window. Managers propose placements; folks can share preferences. Internal moves prioritized before external options.
Mina: Interview process will skew towards senior, cross-functional candidates — recruiters asked to prefer T-shaped profiles to cover broader scope.
Leah: Any changes to approvals? More hoops?
Samir: Small tweak: critical roles still get fast-path; all others go through a quick sync with Priya + Javi. Target is ~48h review in typical cases.
Riley: For teams that need exceptions for customer SLAs, what's the playbook?
Samir: File an exception ticket with product + eng leads and CC me. We'll triage and fast-track where justified.
Mina: Recruiters — pause non-strategic reqs. I'll DM teams with open postings to triage next steps.
Priya: Promotions still proceed; comp pool trimmed slightly (mid-single-digit %). We'll prioritize retention and leveling issues.
Javi: We'll publish an updated team map by Friday with owners and tentative headcount per pod so managers can plan.
Ian: If someone's role is at risk, will there be severance or support? Or is redeployment guaranteed?
Priya: We're committed to redeploying where possible; if not, we'll follow standard separation policy with notice and support. HR will run office hours next week.
Samir: Appreciate the questions — keeping this short so people can reference decisions. If you need an exception or have urgent blockers, drop them here or ping Priya + me.
AllhandsBot: Recording: All-hands staffing follow-up saved to team-docs/all-hands/2026-03-27-staffing.pdf :page_facing_up:
Priya: I'll consolidate exception requests tomorrow and post a status update in #people-ops. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
